messages.content: 想像一下你是一位房地產投資者。你5年前以50萬美元買下了一個物業。該物業的年折舊率為2%。你能計算出該物業目前的折舊值嗎？現在，假設你在同一時間有20萬美元的資金。如果過去5年的年通貨膨脹率為3%，那麼這筆資金今天的價值是多少？另外，假設你借了30萬美元，年利率為4%，用於購買該物業。如果貸款期限為10年，你每月的還款金額是多少？最後，如果你每月計算物業的折舊，而不是每年，那麼該物業的折舊值是多少？

function.name: finance_loan_repayment
function.description: Calculates the monthly repayment for a loan. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

loan_amount.description: The amount borrowed or loaned. This is a float type value.

interest_rate.description: The annual interest rate. This is a float type value.

loan_term.description: The term of the loan in years.

function.name: finance_inflation_adjustment
function.description: Adjusts a sum of money for inflation based on the consumer price index (CPI). Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_sum.description: The initial sum of money. This is a float type value.

years.description: The number of years over which inflation is calculated.

inflation_rate.description: The annual rate of inflation. This is a float type value.

function.name: finance_property_depreciation
function.description: Calculates the depreciated value of a property given its initial cost, depreciation rate, and the number of years. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_cost.description: The initial cost of the property. This is a float type value.

depreciation_rate.description: The annual depreciation rate in percentage. This is a float type value.

years.description: The number of years for which to calculate the depreciation.

monthly.description: If set to true, it will calculate monthly depreciation instead of annually. (optional)

message.reasoning: We need to call functions. Three calculations: property depreciation over 5 years, inflation adjustment for $200k over 5 years, loan repayment monthly for 300k at 4% over 10 years. Also monthly depreciation for property: monthly depreciation over 5 years? Actually monthly depreciation value after 5 years? They ask "如果你每月計算物業的折舊，而不是每年，那麼該物業的折舊值是多少？" Means compute depreciation value after 5 years but using monthly depreciation rate. So we need to compute monthly depreciation rate from annual 2%? If monthly depreciation, we can compute depreciation per month: 2% annual => 0.02/12 per month? But depreciation is usually linear: 2% per year, so monthly depreciation rate = 0.02/12 = 0.0016667. Over 5 years = 60 months. Depreciated value = initial_cost * (1 - monthly_rate)^months? Or linear depreciation monthly: subtract monthly depreciation each month: initial_cost - monthly_rate*initial_cost*months. That equals initial_cost*(1 - monthly_rate*months). monthly_rate*months = 0.0016667*60 = 0.1. So depreciation 10% over 5 years. So value = 500k * (1 - 0.1) = 450k. That matches annual depreciation 2% *5 =10% as well. So same result. But maybe they want monthly depreciation value after 5 years: 500k * (1 - 0.02/12)^60. That yields slightly less: 500k*(1-0.0016667)^60 = 500k*(0.9983333^60). Let's compute approximate: ln(0.9983333) ≈ -0.001667. times 60 = -0.10002. exp(-0.10002)=0.9048. So value ~ 452,400. Slight difference. Which one to use? The function finance_property_depreciation has monthly optional. It likely calculates depreciation using monthly rate. So we should call with monthly=true. That will compute depreciated value after 5 years monthly. So we call function with initial_cost=500000, depreciation_rate=2, years=5, monthly=true. That will give value. For annual depreciation, call with monthly omitted. For inflation adjustment: call finance_inflation_adjustment with initial_sum=200000, years=5, inflation_rate=3. For loan repayment: call finance_loan_repayment with loan_amount=300000, interest_rate=4, loan_term=10. Then output results.
